title: Coefficient 4 with a finite inert-coordinate ledger improvement

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total certificate-prefix language specified in proof.md and family.py. For actual length N, choose k0 as the least prime at least the least positive B with B^5>32*N^3, then k as the least prime at least ceil(12*k0/25); read k input bits as the lower coefficients of a monic degree-k polynomial Q over F_2, reject invalid Q by the exact Frobenius/gcd test, and evaluate the descending-power BK symmetric polynomial on the remaining N-k bits with zero padding, r=ceil((N-k)/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)). Output 0 for N=0 or the explicit failed guards in proof.md. The output is the constant coefficient in F_2[Z]/Q. All k prefix bits are included in N; Q is input, not advice.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This fixed total language is in P, hence in NP with empty witnesses, and in the full pinned B2 model C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-O(N^(4/5)) for every sufficiently large integer N=|x|. In particular liminf over all integer N of C_B2(F_N)/N is at least 4. For this same fixed family the supplied refined disperser dimension d_new gives certified loss 4*k+8*d_new whose ratio to the supplied former loss 4*k+8*d_old tends to 1/2, with d_new and d_old defined in proof.md. Relative to the supplied reference with degree k0 and its refined dimension, the current complete certified loss has limsup ratio at most 99/100, as proved in proof.md Section 9. For the same current family, the exact sharper d_N in proof.md Section 10 improves the certified lower bound by at least 8*ceil(k*t/(t+1)) gates relative to the supplied preceding dimension d_base=k*t+r*(r+3)/2+1. The threshold-halving statement uses the base dimension as specified in Section 8 and also holds for the sharper loss. The averaged full-hypothesis selection further shows d_N=k*t+r*(r+3)/2-k-t*(t+1)/2+2 eventually, so the exact eventual same-family certified improvement is 8*k+4*t*(t+1)-8 gates, as established in Section 10.1. The finite inert-coordinate ledger in elimination.md Section 3 gives C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(4*k+8*d_N)+4 at every sufficiently large integer N. Thus the exact eventual certified improvement over the supplied base-dimension bound is at least 8*k+4*t*(t+1)-4 gates, as shown in proof.md Section 11.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

experiments.purpose: Supplementary exact checks of B2 identities, legal promised-pair lines, potential arithmetic, prime-degree irreducibility, weighted block isolation and executable family evaluation. These bounded checks do not establish universal coverage or the asymptotic theorem.
